from pathlib import Path
import ast
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u082/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    motifs = []
    template_cells = set()
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        c = 0
        while c < w:
            if row[c] == 0:
                c += 1
                continue
            start = c
            while c < w and row[c] != 0:
                c += 1
            if c - start > 1:
                motif = row[start:c]
                motifs.append(motif)
                template_cells.update((r, x) for x in range(start, c))
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value == 0 or (r, c) in template_cells:
                continue
            motif = next(m for m in motifs if value in m)
            anchor = motif.index(value)
            start = c - anchor
            for i, color in enumerate(motif):
                x = start + i
                if 0 <= x < w:
                    out[r][x] = color
    return out
'''
